page.overview:
What is Rock Biter?

Rock Biters were giant worm-like creatures native to Genna. They made their homes in cliffsides.

Rock Biters are seen in the film Predator: Badlands, though only ever in the background. The first one is seen at the film's title card. The name was chosen by Dan Trachtenberg, and was taken from the [https://theneverendingstory.fandom.com/wiki/Pyornkrachzark creature of the same name] from The Neverending Story.
